Collection Description
HW06 / Pool C / FR-13 - Admin dashboard. The dashboard has no endpoint of its own: total revenue (the sum of total_amount over orders with status='delivered') and the total order count are both derived from GET /api/admin/orders, so that endpoint is the API under test. Generated from scripts/cases/api4_fr13_admin_orders.py. The revenue rule makes the aggregate a projection of the FR-10 state machine, so the state folder drives orders into each status and checks whether the figure moves when - and only when - it should. FR-12 / SEC-03 access control is exercised with genuine, forged and tampered tokens. Escalation cases deliberately use LEGAL transitions, so that a refusal can only mean authorisation was checked.
